FIELDS.NAME: Wanderlust Travel Agency
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Wanderlust Travel Agency specializes in providing personalized travel planning and booking services for leisure travelers seeking unique and memorable experiences around the globe. Our core operations involve collaborating with reputable airlines, hotels, and local tour operators to create tailored travel packages that fit our clients' specific interests and budgets. We prioritize customer satisfaction by offering expert travel advice, handling all the logistics of travel itineraries, and providing 24/7 support during trips. In an effort to ensure data security, we have implemented industry-standard cybersecurity measures, including robust firewalls and antivirus protections. Additionally, our team undergoes annual cybersecurity training, reflecting our commitment to protecting sensitive customer information.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Wanderlust Adventure Tours, LLC - a boutique travel company specialized in luxury vacation experiences.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2021, a data breach occurred due to a phishing attack, resulting in unauthorized access to customer information, leading to legal fees and remediation costs totaling $5000. The incident was addressed with enhanced cybersecurity measures thereafter. The status is resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fireproof safe, medium grade, with secure digital lock and alarm system.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Restricted access control with security fencing and 24/7 monitored surveillance system.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The focus is on providing personalized travel services without involvement in activities related to hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its operations. The focus is solely on providing travel planning and booking services for leisure travelers.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The agency's designated inspection coordinator, John Smith, is responsible for checking and verifying the certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. The agency prides itself on its ethical operations and commitment to customer satisfaction.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. Everything is current and compliant with our insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not lease employees to or from other employers as part of its operations. The agency maintains a dedicated staff for its travel planning and booking services.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not currently carry Workers Compensation, as we operate with a fully dedicated staff and have not encountered any needs for employee leasing or subcontracting that would necessitate it.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Wanderlust Travel Agency owns an additional business, Wanderlust Adventure Tours, LLC, which specializes in luxury vacation experiences. This diversification allows us to enhance our travel offerings while maintaining a focus on quality service.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not have any other insurance policies with the same company at this time. All relevant coverage is currently under the active policy numbered WTA-2023-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging products. Our operations focus exclusively on providing travel planning and booking services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus exclusively on providing travel planning and booking services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. Their financial standing appears stable.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on providing travel planning and booking services without involvement in hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations focus exclusively on safe travel planning and booking, without involvement in high-risk activities or unstable regions.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The agency maintains a strong commitment to ethical practices and customer satisfaction.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are no uncorrected fire code violations at Wanderlust Travel Agency. All safety measures and compliance protocols are actively maintained to ensure the safety of both employees and clients.
